description: “At first, the VA wanted me to move to Seattle for treatment, but fellow Marine Senator Dan Sullivan became my champion.” ANCHORAGE, AK — Today, Senator Dan Sullivan’s (R-Alaska) campaign released his second ad, “Nicks Story” highlighting Marine Lance Corporal Nick Woodard who shares his firsthand experience with Senator Sullivan’s unwavering commitment to Alaska’s veterans.
